riasec_explanations.R: You may enjoy practical activities that involve tools, equipment, movement, or producing visible results.
riasec_explanations.I: You may enjoy exploring questions, analysing information, solving problems, and understanding how things work.
riasec_explanations.A: You may enjoy creating, expressing ideas, designing, writing, performing, or working in less structured ways.
riasec_explanations.S: You may enjoy helping, teaching, supporting, communicating with, or contributing to other people.
riasec_explanations.E: You may enjoy leading, persuading, organising initiatives, making decisions, or developing opportunities.
riasec_explanations.C: You may enjoy organising information, following clear procedures, checking details, and maintaining accurate records.

Submit the records requested by the TCC registrar or admissions office.
Complete any programme-specific screening that TCC formally adopts and publishes.

bs-information-technology.description: Studies hardware and software technologies used to plan, install, customise, operate, administer, and maintain information technology infrastructure and computing solutions for organisational needs.

learning_area_descriptions.IT infrastructure: Plan, install, customise, operate, manage, administer, and maintain the hardware and software infrastructure used by an organisation.
learning_area_descriptions.Computing solutions: Identify user needs and select, develop, apply, integrate, and manage computing technologies that address them.
learning_area_descriptions.Systems and network administration: Configure and support computer systems, networks, services, and their secure day-to-day operation.
learning_area_descriptions.Application and database development: Develop web or application solutions and work with the databases and integrated systems that support organisational processes.

career_directions: Information security, systems integration, or technical support
bs-information-technology.strand_guidance: STEM supports mathematics and analytical preparation, while TVL-ICT provides practical exposure to computer systems and digital tools.
bs-information-technology.readiness_prompt: The CMO expects graduates to address organisational user needs through the selection, development, application, integration, and management of computing technologies.

content_source.reference: Article IV, Sections 5.1(c), 5.2, 5.4 and 6.3; Article V, Section 8

bs-business-administration.description: The Financial Management major prepares graduates for financial-management and related work through knowledge of financial institutions, established financial theories and methodologies, analytical tools, ethics, regulation, governance, and a competitive global perspective.

learning_area_descriptions.Financial institutions and markets: Study banking, credit, trust operations, insurance, foreign-currency markets, money markets, capital markets, and financial-securities markets.
learning_area_descriptions.Corporate finance and investment: Develop knowledge for corporate-finance, investment-management, treasury, and related financial-management decisions.
learning_area_descriptions.Financial analysis and decision-making: Apply established financial theories, methodologies, and analytical tools to evaluate information and support effective decisions.
learning_area_descriptions.Ethics, regulation, and governance: Approach financial decisions with attention to ethics, market integrity, regulation, good governance, and global competition.

career_directions: Banking, credit, collections, or treasury work
Investment, trading, insurance, or financial-analysis work
bs-business-administration.strand_guidance: ABM offers the closest preparation in business, accounting, management, and entrepreneurship; GAS also provides broad academic preparation.
bs-business-administration.readiness_prompt: The CMO frames effective financial decision-making around analytical tools, ethics, market integrity, regulation, good governance, and a competitive global perspective.

content_source.note: The exact CMO is referenced by the project but is not currently stored in docs/cmo. Existing guidance remains proposed until the document is locally reviewed.

bs-criminology.description: Focuses on crime, public safety, justice systems, investigation, and community-based prevention.

learning_area_descriptions.Criminal justice: Study how law enforcement, courts, corrections, and related institutions respond to crime and protect rights.
learning_area_descriptions.Law-enforcement foundations: Build knowledge of professional ethics, legal procedures, public service, and responsible community relations.
learning_area_descriptions.Investigation: Develop foundational skills in observation, interviewing, evidence handling, documentation, and analytical reporting.
learning_area_descriptions.Community safety: Examine crime prevention, risk reduction, public-safety planning, and cooperation with local communities.

bs-criminology.strand_guidance: HUMSS supports study of society, governance, communication, and human behaviour, while GAS offers broad preparation across disciplines.
bs-criminology.readiness_prompt: Ask TCC about current fitness, conduct, health, or other programme requirements before making a decision.

content_source.reference: Article I, Section 1; Article IV, Sections 5.2, 5.3, 6.3 and 6.5

bs-hospitality-management.description: Develops the operational and management competencies needed in hospitality and tourism, including food production, accommodation, food-and-beverage service, events, and other emerging sectors of the industry.

learning_area_descriptions.Food production and service: Produce food products and services in line with enterprise standards and safe hospitality operations.
learning_area_descriptions.Food and beverage operations: Apply management skills to food-and-beverage service and provide coordinated service based on industry standards.
learning_area_descriptions.Front office and guest services: Perform full guest-cycle services and communicate professionally with guests, colleagues, and other stakeholders.
learning_area_descriptions.Housekeeping and risk management: Maintain housekeeping services for guests and facilities and plan measures that support a safe and secure workplace.

bs-hospitality-management.strand_guidance: TVL-Home Economics can provide practical hospitality and food-service exposure, while ABM supports the management side of hospitality operations.
bs-hospitality-management.readiness_prompt: The CMO requires operational and managerial preparation and identifies longer practicum training as part of preparing graduates for hospitality-industry work.

content_source.reference: Article IV, Sections 5 and 6; Article V, Sections 8 and 9

bachelor-elementary-education.description: An undergraduate teacher-education degree that prepares individuals to teach at the elementary level through multidisciplinary preparation in subject content and pedagogy.

learning_area_descriptions.Learner diversity: Develop an in-depth understanding of diverse elementary learners and select appropriate, culturally relevant learning experiences.
learning_area_descriptions.Pedagogical content knowledge: Build comprehensive content and teaching knowledge across elementary subject areas and use suitable teaching-learning methods.
learning_area_descriptions.Assessment and evaluation: Design and use appropriate assessment tools, interpret results, keep accurate records, and provide timely feedback.
learning_area_descriptions.Teaching tools and technology: Use communication, higher-order thinking, learning resources, and technology to support and improve teaching and learning.

bachelor-elementary-education.strand_guidance: HUMSS develops communication and understanding of people and society; GAS provides broad preparation across subjects taught in elementary school.
bachelor-elementary-education.readiness_prompt: The CMO prepares graduates to practise the teaching profession at the elementary level; current professional-licensure requirements are governed separately.

content_source.note: The exact CMO is referenced by the project but is not currently stored in docs/cmo. Existing guidance remains proposed until the document is locally reviewed.

bachelor-secondary-education.description: Prepares learners for secondary teaching, including the currently recorded English, Filipino, and Social Studies or Araling Panlipunan majors.

learning_area_descriptions.Teaching methods: Design lessons, discussions, and learning activities suited to junior and senior high school classrooms.
learning_area_descriptions.Adolescent learning: Study the cognitive, social, emotional, and developmental needs that influence how adolescents learn.
learning_area_descriptions.Subject specialisation: Build deeper content and teaching knowledge in the selected English, Filipino, or Social Studies major.
learning_area_descriptions.Classroom assessment: Develop fair assessments, interpret learner performance, and use feedback to improve secondary instruction.

bachelor-secondary-education.strand_guidance: HUMSS aligns closely with the recorded English, Filipino, and Social Studies majors; GAS offers broad preparation for further subject specialisation.
bachelor-secondary-education.readiness_prompt: Confirm the available major with TCC and discuss your interest in teaching, communication, and subject-focused study.

bs-midwifery.description: A four-year degree comprising general education and professional courses that prepare future midwives for higher-level practice, including intensive fourth-year clinical practicum and midwifery specialisation.

learning_area_descriptions.Maternal care: Provide culturally appropriate antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum care, including early detection, emergency management, and referral of complicated conditions.
learning_area_descriptions.Newborn care: Assess and care for newborns, support breastfeeding and family education, detect complications, and refer cases outside the midwifery scope of practice.
learning_area_descriptions.Primary and community health: Provide health education and primary-health-care services to individuals, families, and communities using promotion and disease-prevention strategies.
learning_area_descriptions.Professional and clinical practice: Apply obstetrics, neonatology, social science, public health, ethics, communication, documentation, law, and professional accountability in supervised practice.

bs-midwifery.strand_guidance: STEM strengthens preparation in the sciences, while relevant TVL-Home Economics health-care subjects may provide practical care experience.
bs-midwifery.readiness_prompt: The CMO states that the four-year programme includes intensive fourth-year clinical practicum and prepares graduates to take the Midwifery Licensure Examination.

content_source.reference: Article IV, Sections 5 and 6; Article V, Section 8

bachelor-library-information-science.description: Studies the development, deployment, and management of information resources and services in print, non-print, electronic, and digital formats, including the use of information technology in library operations.

learning_area_descriptions.Managing information resources: Select, acquire, catalogue, classify, index, manage, preserve, and provide access to print, multimedia, electronic, and digital resources.
learning_area_descriptions.Managing information services: Identify users' needs and deliver access, reference, reader-advisory, information-literacy, outreach, and related public services.
learning_area_descriptions.Information tools and technologies: Use hardware, software, internet services, web applications, automation systems, and security practices in library and information work.
learning_area_descriptions.Managing information organisations: Apply planning, policy, budgeting, project and personnel management, research, public relations, collaboration, and facilities management.

career_directions: Entry-level library, documentation, or records support
Archives, preservation, database, or library-systems work
bachelor-library-information-science.strand_guidance: HUMSS supports research and communication, while TVL-ICT can help with digital information systems and technology-enabled library services.
bachelor-library-information-science.readiness_prompt: The CMO distinguishes entry-level roles from professional librarian roles that require the necessary licence; confirm current PRC and TCC requirements.

content_source.reference: Article IV, Sections 5 and 6; Article V, Sections 8 and 9

bs-sociology.description: Examines social life, groups, societies, world systems, and virtual communities, with attention to the changing relationship between individuals and society.

learning_area_descriptions.Sociological concepts and theories: Explain and apply sociological concepts and theories to understand social life and the relationship between individuals and society.
learning_area_descriptions.Social research: Design, carry out, and assess research using appropriate sociological approaches, methods, and analytical tools.
learning_area_descriptions.Social problems and issues: Analyse social problems and issues in light of economic, political, ecological, and sociocultural trends.
learning_area_descriptions.Social programmes and professional pract: Apply sociological research skills in designing, implementing, and assessing social programmes and projects while communicating responsibly and observing professional ethics.

Social problems and issues: Economic, political, ecological, and sociocultural trends

career_directions: Development work in academic, corporate, government, local, or international organisations
bs-sociology.strand_guidance: HUMSS provides close preparation in society, culture, communication, and social sciences; GAS offers a broad academic foundation.
bs-sociology.readiness_prompt: The CMO emphasizes sociological theories and research methodologies for understanding, analysing, and addressing social problems and issues.

content_source.note: No exact programme PSG is currently stored in docs/cmo. Existing guidance remains proposed and must not be inferred from Sociology or general career-learning material.

bs-community-development.description: Focuses on participatory community work, programme planning, local development, and social mobilisation.

learning_area_descriptions.Community organising: Build relationships, support local leadership, facilitate participation, and help communities act on shared concerns.
learning_area_descriptions.Development planning: Assess community needs and resources, set priorities, and design inclusive strategies for local development.
learning_area_descriptions.Project work: Plan, coordinate, monitor, document, and evaluate community-based programmes and services.
learning_area_descriptions.Participatory research: Work with community members to gather evidence, interpret local conditions, and shape practical responses.

bs-community-development.strand_guidance: HUMSS supports communication, social analysis, and understanding communities; GAS provides flexible preparation for interdisciplinary community work.
bs-community-development.readiness_prompt: Discuss your interest in community service, facilitation, fieldwork, teamwork, and project planning.

bachelor-physical-education.description: Prepares learners to teach and facilitate physical activity, movement, fitness, sports, and wellness education.

learning_area_descriptions.Movement education: Understand movement concepts and design safe activities that develop coordination, body awareness, and physical literacy.
learning_area_descriptions.Fitness: Learn principles of exercise, conditioning, wellness, and age-appropriate fitness assessment and programme planning.
learning_area_descriptions.Sports instruction: Teach sport skills, rules, teamwork, safety, officiating, and responsible participation in physical activities.
learning_area_descriptions.Teaching methods: Plan inclusive physical education lessons, manage active learning environments, and assess learner progress.

bachelor-physical-education.strand_guidance: The Sports Track offers the closest activity-based preparation, while HUMSS and GAS support communication and broad academic readiness for teaching.
bachelor-physical-education.readiness_prompt: Ask TCC about current physical, health, practicum, or activity requirements before making a decision.
